page.layout: One block of running text in a single column. No margin notes, page number or footnotes. Running head at the top; catchword at the lower right.

main_text.l: compendiario, plana, methodico & plenio-
re comprehenderem, meisque auditoribus
publice in Schola proponerem ac commu-
nicarem. Itaque perpaucis abhinc annis
hunc laborem, quamlibet durum &
molestum, alacri animo suscepi, susceptum-
que feliciter diuini Numinis auxilio ad-
iutus ad finem perduxi. Sed mihi eo tem-
poris ne in mentem quidem veniebat
il-lum typis committere & diuulgare. Vi-
debatur enim nimis adhuc rudis esse &
informis fœtus, qui dignus non esset,
ut in lucem, conspectumque doc-
torum virorum veniret. At postea præter spem
& opinionem meam accidit, ut a multis
etiam magni nominis viris approbare-
tur, qui etiam ad eius editionem procu-r-
andam & maturandam variis, iisque
grauissimis argumentis me excitarunt.
Vt igitur cum illorum voluntati obsecun-
darem, quorum apud me plurimum valet
auctoritas, tum Rempub. literariam mea

page.notes: Long s rendered as plain s throughout. Catchword "quali-" is a half word at the lower right and is kept as printed. The running head is set in spaced capitals. No page number is printed. Hyphens at line ends are kept as printed (plenio-re, tem-poris, il-lum, Vi-debatur, adiu-, obsecun-, approbare-, procu-, ad-iutus). The page begins mid-paragraph, so the first paragraph is marked cont="true".
